connector.name: Screenshotrender MCP
connector.registryDescription: Capture website screenshots from any MCP client via the ScreenshotRender API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package screenshotrender-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the faridmth account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCREENSHOTRENDER_API_KEY
env.description: Your ScreenshotRender API key (starts with sr-). Get one at https://screenshotrender.com.
